en-US.{0} 笔账单快到期或已过还款日，打开钱包查看。: Bills due soon or past their due date: {0}. Open the wallet to see them.
en-US.{0} 项福利快到期，打开钱包查看。: Benefits ending soon: {0}. Open the wallet to see them.
en-US.没有获得通知权限，提醒保持关闭。可以在 Chrome 的网站设置里修改后再试。: Notification permission wasn't granted, so reminders stay off. You can change this in Chrome's site settings and try again.
en-US.通知权限已被关闭，目前不会提醒。: Notification permission is off, so no reminders will appear.
en-US.在通知里显示账单金额（锁屏上可能被看到）: Show bill amounts in notifications (they may be visible on a lock screen)
en-US.这是一条测试通知，提醒已开启。: This is a test notification. Reminders are on.
en-US.默认关闭。开启时 Chrome 会请求通知权限，关闭后不再提醒。只在 Chrom: Off by default. Turning this on asks Chrome for notification permission. Reminders are checked only while a wallet page is open in Chrome, so none appear once it's closed. Benefits can also use the calendar reminders on the benefits page; bills have no such backup yet.
en-US.默认关闭。开启时 Chrome 会请求通知权限，关闭后不再提醒。钱包页面关闭时也: Off by default. Chrome asks for notification permission when you turn this on, and reminders stop when you turn it off. Reminders also arrive with the wallet page closed, as long as Chrome is running. If Chrome wasn't running when one was due, it arrives after Chrome next starts, unless it's out of date by then. Reminders are planned for the next {0} days from the data you had when you last opened the wallet. After paying at your bank, mark the bill as handled in the wallet to stop them.
en-US.已处理、银行显示无需付款、未读取的账单不会提醒；自动还款已开启且读数较新的账单也: No reminders for bills that are handled, marked no payment due by the bank, or not read, or for bills on autopay with a recent reading. A due date with no year doesn't remind either, because there's no way to tell how far away it is.
en-US.自动还款已开启，请到银行核对是否已扣款。: Autopay is on. Check with the bank that the payment went through.
en-US.钱包不知道你是否已还款；请到银行核对，或标记已处理。: The wallet can't tell whether you paid. Check with the bank, or mark it handled.
en-US.上次读到的还款日已过，读数太旧，无法判断这期是否已还。请刷新。: The last due date read has passed and the reading is too old to tell whether this bill was paid. Refresh to check.
en-US.银行只显示月日，所以不计算剩余天数。: The bank shows only month and day, so no day count is given.
en-US.已标记本期已处理；钱包没有付款。: Marked handled for this cycle. The wallet made no payment.
en-US.{0} 张卡的账单未读取或读数已过期，暂时无法判断是否要还款: Cards with unread or old bill readings: {0}. The wallet can't tell whether payment is needed.
en-US.搜索卡名、银行或尾号: Search card, bank or last digits
en-US.钱包不会替你付款。“已处理”只是你在本机的记号，下一期账单会重新提醒。: The wallet never pays for you. “Handled” is only your own note on this device, and the next bill shows up again.
en-US.读到的账单没有应付金额: Statement read shows nothing to pay
en-US.年费日（你设置了年费日的卡）: Annual fee date (cards where you set one)
en-US.年费日提前天数: Days before the annual fee date
